name: Spring Boot
description: Project-level Java framework for production-ready Spring applications.
longDescription: Spring Boot applications are generated per project with the Spring Initializr and built with Maven or Gradle. DevForge treats Spring Boot as a project recipe and can prepare the required JDK and Maven toolchain.
caveats: Spring Boot dependencies live inside each Maven/Gradle project, not on the operating system.
The Spring Initializr website can also generate the project if you prefer a graphical workflow.

dependencies.reason: Modern Spring Boot releases require Java 17 or newer.
Maven is a common build tool for Spring Boot; Gradle is also supported.

projectRecipe.summary: Generate a Spring Boot project with the Spring Initializr and run it with Maven.

commands.label: Download a Maven project from Spring Initializr

notes: Check start.spring.io for the current supported Spring Boot version before generating a project.
Gradle projects are equally supported; choose Gradle on the Initializr if preferred.
